//: An .mdv file is Markdown, so this mirrors VS Code's Markdown configuration
and adds the two things Markdown does not have: MDV attribute notation is
indentation-sensitive at exactly 2 spaces per level (SPEC 5.3.1), and `#` is
a comment inside a block header (SPEC 5.3.1) even though it is a heading in
prose. `lineComment` is set because the header is where an author actually
reaches for Ctrl+/; toggling it on a prose line produces a heading, which is
why the block-scoped `mdv-block` language below exists at all.

indentationRules.//: SPEC 5.3.1: exactly 2 spaces per level. A key ending in `:` opens a level; a block scalar introducer does too.

onEnterRules.//: Continue a block-sequence item inside a header.
